title: Fantastic Four: The Baby Galactus Wanted
description: The Fantastic Four: First Steps (2025), Earth-828 film continuity; not the 2005, 2007 or 2015 adaptations. A connected, source-reviewed illustrated recap with the central reversal reserved for the final act.
hook: A planet-eater offers to spare Earth. His price is one family's baby.
payoff: Four years later, Sue finds a green-cloaked stranger beside Franklin: Doctor Doom. The film leaves his plan unanswered. For more stories like this, subscribe.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: A planet-eater offers to spare Earth. His price is one family's baby.
units.onscreen: A CHILD — OR AN ENTIRE PLANET
units.visual_query: A CHILD — OR AN ENTIRE PLANET

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: In The Fantastic Four: First Steps, four astronauts are already celebrated heroes. Reed and Sue are expecting their first child.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: The Silver Surfer warns that Galactus is coming. The team flies into space and watches him destroy another world before he brings them aboard.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Galactus senses their unborn son's cosmic power. He offers Earth for the child, who could inherit his hunger. The family refuses and runs.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: The Surfer pursues their ship. Reed slingshots around a neutron star, buying their escape. During the chase, Sue gives birth to Franklin.
units.onscreen: A BIRTH DURING A COSMIC CHASE
units.visual_query: A BIRTH DURING A COSMIC CHASE

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Back on Earth, crowds demand the baby be surrendered. Sue refuses to sacrifice Franklin or abandon humanity. Reed plans to teleport the whole planet away.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: The world builds the bridges, but the Surfer destroys them. Johnny saves the last one and confronts Shalla-Bal: she serves Galactus to protect her own world.
units.onscreen: THE HERALD ONCE HAD THE SAME CHOICE
units.visual_query: THE HERALD ONCE HAD THE SAME CHOICE

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Recordings of the worlds she helped destroy break through her resolve. She flees. The family changes the plan: lure Galactus through the remaining bridge instead.
units.onscreen: ONE BRIDGE LEFT. A DIFFERENT PLAN.
units.visual_query: ONE BRIDGE LEFT. A DIFFERENT PLAN.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: New York evacuates underground through Mole Man's city. Franklin becomes the bait, but Galactus finds the real baby. Ben rescues the stretched Reed.
units.onscreen: THE TRAP DOES NOT GO TO PLAN
units.visual_query: THE TRAP DOES NOT GO TO PLAN

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Reed retrieves Franklin while Sue pushes Galactus toward the portal. Johnny prepares a final sacrifice, but Shalla-Bal takes his place and drives her master through.
units.onscreen: THE FINAL PUSH COMES FROM HIS HERALD
units.visual_query: THE FINAL PUSH COMES FROM HIS HERALD

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Sue collapses and dies from the effort. Then Franklin revives her. The family that refused to surrender one child has saved the world.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: Four years later, Sue finds a green-cloaked stranger beside Franklin: Doctor Doom. The film leaves his plan unanswered. For more stories like this, subscribe.
units.onscreen: FOUR YEARS LATER: A DIFFERENT DANGER
units.visual_query: FOUR YEARS LATER: A DIFFERENT DANGER
